prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a quiet moment at a construction site. On the left, a worker in a yellow hard hat stands firmly beside a stack of gray bricks. In the center, a foreman wearing an orange vest points toward the unfinished steel framework above. To the right, a small brown dog sits patiently on a wooden crate, watching the scene unfold. Near the dog, a woman in blue overalls looks at a clipboard held by the foreman. Behind them, a large yellow crane looms against the pale sky, its arm extended horizontally. The worker in the yellow hard hat is handing a rolled-up blueprint to the foreman in the orange vest. The woman in blue overalls is standing next to the small brown dog. There is no heavy machinery operating in the background. The soft washes of color define the dusty air and the rough textures of the materials without sharp lines. The composition remains simple, focusing only on these five distinct figures and their immediate surroundings. The interaction between the two humans involves the transfer of plans, while the other pair shares proximity without direct contact. The dog remains still, observing the human activity with calm curiosity.
